title: Stock-Rotation Returns on Ship-To Fulfillment Accounts
content:
**Returns desk guidance and customer self-service card.** A stock-rotation return lets the customer send back unopened stocked merchandise of a returnable item class that has stopped moving, against a yearly rotation allowance.

### Return window

A customer-reason return (ordered in error or no longer needed) is authorized only when the request is made no later than the level's return window in calendar days after the ship date of the returned line, except that a stock-rotation return, and only a stock-rotation return, is authorized after that window under the rotation allowance; every other customer-reason return stays inside the window.

### How the return is submitted and what follows

The customer submits the stock-rotation return on its own account, as one RMA line for the rotation item with the return reason no longer needed and the return method customer-shipped, carrying the invoiced unit price of the line, the unit price of its one shipment; its receipt, inspection, restocking fee and credit then follow the return rules as for any customer-reason return.

### Allowance timing

The stock-rotation allowance is fixed only after the review of the ship-to's service level for its most recent opening anniversary has been recorded.

Put another way: until the review of the ship-to's service level for its most recent opening anniversary has been recorded, the stock-rotation allowance is not fixed.

### The customer's tool: `submit_stock_rotation_return_550cd403`

**Capability.** Submits, on the customer's own account, a stock-rotation return for one shipped order line of a Ship-To Fulfillment Account. The call issues one return material authorization (RMA) line for the item, marked as a no-longer-needed return of an unopened stocked standard item that the customer ships back, for the quantity and unit price supplied; no credit, fee or receipt is booked by this call. Once stored, the return lookup for the ship-to shows the new authorized RMA line.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `submit_stock_rotation_return_550cd403` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ship_to_id` | the internal identifier of the ship-to the goods were shipped to, as returned by the ship-to account lookup for the customer | identifier |
| `order_number` | the sales order number of the shipped line being returned | SO-NNNNNNN, copied character for character from the order or return lookup |
| `line_number` | the line number of the shipped line on that sales order, as shown on the order lookup | integer of 1 or more |
| `sku` | the Corbett item number of the item being returned | copied character for character from the order or return lookup |
| `quantity` | the number of units authorized for return | integer in selling units, never negative |
| `unit_price` | the invoiced unit price of the shipped line | USD with 4 decimal places, rounded half up at the fourth decimal |

**Return.** A dictionary receipt: `status` is the word authorized when the RMA line was stored; `rma_number` is the RMA number issued, format RMA-NNNNNN; `ship_to_id`, `order_number`, `line_number` and `sku` echo the line returned; `quantity` is the integer quantity authorized; `unit_price` is the unit price recorded, in USD to 4 decimal places; `event_date` is the RMA date, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
